remarks: Bright & exceptionally spacious 1-bedroom, 1-bath flat offering 1,045 square feet of airy living space in one of Westport's most convenient corridors. Soaring 9+ foot vaulted ceilings elevate the open living and dining areas, while rich hardwood floors bring warmth throughout the entire home. The galley kitchen features a sunlit breakfast nook tucked at the end, ideal for morning coffee or a dedicated work-from-home setup. Enjoy everyday comfort with in-unit laundry and room proportions rarely found in a 1-bedroom rental.Commuter and lifestyle convenience is unmatched: just minutes to the Southport Metro-North station and I-95 for an effortless commute, with Westport shops, dining, and beaches right at your fingertips.
